scenes.image: A timber safari lodge veranda at golden hour with Mount Meru on the horizon beyond flowering jacaranda trees. Below the veranda, two open-roofed safari vehicles are parked side-on on red earth, dust glowing in the low sun. A guide in khaki, seen from behind, lifts a cool box into the nearest vehicle. Warm cinematic light, long shadows, shallow depth of field, 35mm photograph.

A dark wooden back-office desk in a timber lodge late at night, lit by one brass desk lamp. A pair of reading glasses rests on the bare polished wood, a brass rubber stamp lies on its side, a fountain pen and a cold cup of tea sit nearby. Tense, tired mood, deep shadows, warm tungsten light, cinematic photograph.

A bright, calm hotel reception in a timber and volcanic-stone lodge in the morning. A receptionist seen from behind hands a brass room key across a polished wooden counter to a guest in travel clothes. Potted palms, woven baskets, soft daylight through tall windows, quiet and orderly, soft focus, cinematic photograph.

scenes.line: Malipo ya msimu yanaingia bila usumbufu.
scenes.image: A lodge terrace at dusk with lanterns glowing along a stone wall. Three guests seen from behind raise sundowner glasses toward the silhouette of Mount Meru against a deep violet and blue sky fading to magenta at the horizon. Calm, celebratory, cinematic photograph.
